# A2A PHP SDK

> PHP SDK for the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol, version 1.0. Same classes and layout as the official Python SDK (a2aproject/a2a-python), with camelCase methods. Framework-agnostic core on PSR-7/15/17/18, plus a Laravel bridge. Package: praveendias1180/a2a-php (Composer). Status: stable 1.x (SemVer from 1.0); client and server are done, the server passes the official A2A TCK (MUST, SHOULD and MAY over JSON-RPC and HTTP+JSON) and interoperates with the official Python SDK both ways. Push notifications (webhooks with SSRF protection and retries), Agent Card signing (JWS over RFC 8785, interoperable with the Python SDK) and extension negotiation are supported. Laravel bridge: praveendias1180/a2a-laravel (Route::a2a, queued execution on queue workers with live SSE, Redis Streams or database event log); a Laravel app on PHP-FPM + nginx with the queued runner also passes the TCK MUST level.

Key facts:

- Targets A2A specification 1.0 (types generated from a2aproject/A2A a2a.proto v1.0.0). A2A 0.3 is supported through a compatibility layer (A2A\Compat\V0_3): the client talks to 0.3 agents automatically, and servers answer 0.3 clients with enableV03Compat (Laravel: A2A_V0_3_COMPAT=true).
- Requires PHP 8.2+. Install: `composer require praveendias1180/a2a-php`.
- Class names match the Python SDK: AgentExecutor, RequestContext, EventQueue, TaskUpdater, TaskStore, DefaultRequestHandler, ClientFactory, A2ACardResolver.
- PHP-FPM can't keep work running after a request: the executor runs in a PHP Fiber (events stream live), and tasks plus stream events live in a shared store (PdoTaskStore + PdoQueueManager on SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL) so separate PHP processes can subscribe and cancel. The Laravel bridge adds QueuedTaskRunner (executors on queue workers) and RedisQueueManager (Redis Streams).
- Not affiliated with the A2A Project or the Linux Foundation. Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [Home](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/): what it is, a side-by-side PHP / Laravel / Python example
- [Install](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/get-started/install/)
- [Your first agent](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/get-started/first-agent/): executor, Agent Card, serving it
- [Call an agent](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/get-started/call-an-agent/): the client and streaming
- [A2A in five minutes](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/concepts/a2a-in-five-minutes/): objects, task lifecycle, operations
- [Conformance](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/reference/conformance/): official A2A TCK results
- [Running agents in PHP](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/concepts/running-agents-in-php/): task runners, queues, SSE behind nginx, cancellation
- [Laravel: install and first agent](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/guides/laravel/): Route::a2a, a2a:make-executor, auth and task owners, A2A::client
- [Laravel: queued execution](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/guides/laravel-queues/): QueuedTaskRunner, Horizon/supervisor, cancellation, Redis vs database events
- [Laravel: streaming behind nginx](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/guides/laravel-sse-nginx/)
- [Laravel: storage and pruning](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/guides/laravel-storage/)

- [Push notifications](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/guides/push-notifications/): webhooks, SSRF protection, retries
- [Signing the Agent Card](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/guides/card-signing/): JWS over the canonical card, verification
- [Extensions](https://praveendias1180.github.io/a2a-php/guides/extensions/): declaring, activating, required extensions
